zh: 我让你失望了，这次考试没考好。
old_en: I let you down this time because I didn't do well on the exam.
new_en: I let you down because I didn't do well on this exam.

zh: 这次我没有按时完成任务，让你失望了。
old_en: I failed to finish the task on time, which let you down.
new_en: I didn't finish the task on time and let you down.

zh: 这次没帮上忙，我不想让你失望。
old_en: I didn't want to let you down, so I didn't help this time.
new_en: I didn't want to let you down by not helping this time.

zh: 抱歉这次没做到，希望没让你失望。
old_en: Sorry I couldn't achieve it this time, I hope I didn't let you down.
new_en: Sorry I couldn't do it this time; I hope I didn't let you down.
